carousel.item1_para: Immerse yourself in a stay that feels genuinely personal — where every detail is crafted to make you feel at home far from home.
carousel.item2_para: Every corner of our hotel is designed with intention — creating moments that feel warm, effortless, and truly yours.
carousel.item3_para: Let your body and mind unwind. Our spa and wellness spaces are designed to dissolve the weight of the everyday.
carousel.item4_para: Start your day with fresh coffee or wind down in the evening — our cafés are designed to offer comfort, flavor, and a space to relax.
carousel.item5_para: Wake up to open water. Each room is a quiet sanctuary designed to let the sea in and the noise of the world out.

rooms.para: Cozy, bright, and full of thoughtful details: our rooms combine charm with modern comfort. Whether with a view or a peaceful corner, you'll find comfort, security, and the feeling of being at home.
rooms.room1_desc: Spacious and welcoming, the Family Room is designed for comfort and togetherness with flexible sleeping space and a relaxing atmosphere. Perfect for families, it includes all essential amenities such as bathroom essentials, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast for a convenient stay.
rooms.room2_desc: The Junior Suite blends comfort with a touch of luxury, offering a spacious layout and a cozy seating area. Designed for a relaxing stay, it includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast to make your experience effortless.
rooms.room3_desc: Enjoy beautiful sea views from this elegant Junior Suite, designed with comfort and light in mind. A perfect balance of style and relaxation, it comes with bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast for a complete stay.
rooms.room4_desc: Indulge in luxury with the King Suite featuring a private spa bath for ultimate relaxation. Spacious and refined, this suite includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast, creating a premium and comfortable experience.
rooms.room5_desc: Designed for comfort and practicality, the Large Twin Room offers generous space with twin beds and a calm setting. Ideal for friends or colleagues, it includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast for a smooth stay.
rooms.room6_desc: Wake up to calming sea views in this Twin Room designed for relaxation and simplicity. Bright and comfortable, it comes with bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast to enhance your stay.
rooms.room7_name: Deluxe Twin Room with Sea View
rooms.room7_desc: Enjoy elevated comfort with stunning sea views in this Deluxe Twin Room. Designed with style and space in mind, it offers bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast for a refined stay.
rooms.room8_desc: The Deluxe Twin Room offers a perfect blend of space and comfort with modern design and thoughtful details. Ideal for a relaxed stay, it includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast.
rooms.room9_name: Deluxe Double Room with Sea View
rooms.room9_desc: Experience comfort with a view in this Deluxe Double Room overlooking the sea. Elegant and relaxing, it includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast to ensure a pleasant stay.
rooms.room10_desc: The Superior King Room offers enhanced comfort with a spacious layout and premium bedding. Designed for relaxation, it includes bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast for a complete experience.
rooms.room11_name: Superior Twin Room with City View
rooms.room11_desc: Enjoy city views from this comfortable Superior Twin Room, designed for a peaceful and convenient stay. With bathroom amenities, wardrobe, room service, and breakfast included, it offers everything you need.

services.wellness_heading: Indulge in Your Time at Lov Ella
services.wellness_para: A women's wellness space built around intention. Lov Ella offers a curated range of treatments from hair care to skin rituals in an environment that feels like it was made just for you.
services.marmara_para: Refined grooming for the modern man. Marmara is a precise, calm, and considered space where every visit feels like a reset not just a haircut.
services.chariot_para: A quiet corner where the morning coffee tastes different. Our Chariot Café brings together fresh ingredients, unhurried service, and a view that makes every cup worth savoring.
services.habka_para: Rooftop breezes and handcrafted plates. Habka is where the day winds down slowly an open-air experience designed for those who believe the best meals deserve the best views.

testimonials.heading: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.para: Real experiences and honest words. Discover how our guests have experienced their stay at the Ocean View Hotel. Authentic impressions that say more than any description.
testimonials.t1_review: The Ocean View Hotel is a good choice for business stays in Kuwait. Rooms are clean, quiet, and well maintained, and the staff is professional and efficient.
testimonials.t2_review: I enjoyed my stay here a lot. The rooms are nice and clean, and they're spacious which I love! Also the staff are very kind. Two people made my stay stand out more and it was Marty and Mr Salah!! They're very nice and welcoming and they are part of the reason I'll be back to this hotel.
testimonials.t3_review: My stay in Ocean view hotel was good. The staff was very cooperative and the rooms are spacious. Mr sajjad is the front desk person on whom you can fully rely upon..over all a good stay for me.
testimonials.t4_review: I stayed for 7 nights. The staffs are friendly and highly professional. Indeed the location and rooms are quite good. There is Spa, café and its very near to great mall and beaches.
testimonials.t5_review: Wonderful stay at hotel ocean view thanks so much Mr sajad & Mr Shehab for make wonderful stay professional team I recommend everyone see you soon
testimonials.t6_review: It was ist time this hotel luxury property with professional reception welcomed Team specially Mr salad make check in very smooth with comfortable service see you soon inshallah Mr sajad
testimonials.t7_review: This is my vist hotel.ist meet with mr sajad from reception great welcome professional smile face helping & well knowledge personality's I will recommend everyone to visit this hotel reason reception ist impression great thanks.
testimonials.t8_review: An indescribably luxurious hotel experience. From the very first moment, I felt I was in the presence of a high level of professionalism and attention to detail. The reception was sophisticated, the service elegant, and the cleanliness clearly reflected the standards of a luxury hotel.
testimonials.t9_review: Great place to be in, and an amazing staff to support. Especially Marlyin at the front desk, she catered to all my family's needs throughout the stay.
testimonials.t10_review: I came for the first time to this hotel the check was very professional and wonderful. Mr.sajad is the professional person from the reception and very helpful and great hospitality. The rooms are very comfortable and great service.

eventhall.para: Host your most special occasions in a setting designed to impress. From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, our elegant event spaces, refined service, and ocean-inspired ambiance create memories that last a lifetime.
